new guidance concept; PENDING until the pack lands, then flip active in
Proverbs 3:5-6 is deliberately NOT asserted here even though it is the
verse most people associate with guidance: it anchors trust-in-god, and
the guidance pack cross-links it via related: rather than duplicating the
anchor. For the query 'guidance' no lexical or curated rung reaches it,
and an assertion that cannot fail is decoration.
'which way to go' is recorded as unreachable by design: it normalizes to
the single token 'way' (which/to are stopwords, 'go' falls under the
3-char floor), and a bare 'way' entry would fire the concept on 'I am
the way'. Isaiah 30:21 and Ps 25:4-5 / Ps 119:105 are anchors but not
asserted — their chapters are not yet in the fixture corpus (see
corpus-needs.md); add assertions when they land.
